title: Environment BuildTest accepted command and output collection
alt: Authenticated dispatch locates an existing Source Control workspace. The Source Control owner creates verified repository input from the current run pin. Core keeps the confirmed command unchanged and saves the separate source input and exact seed in the original checkpoint before reservation. Retry reuses saved input. Environment resolves immutable command metadata, reads bounded raw input from the fixed Core owner, verifies length and digest, and rechecks the owner before reservation. Environment saves the stable operation before provider effects. A gated command Pod runs under an offline policy; verified exit zero starts a separate read-only collector. The collector returns a bounded file receipt tied to its Pod UID and request fingerprint. Core retains checkpoint and run-state ownership. Provider preparation and complete output export remain unconnected.

steps.label: Completed input allows later decisions; running input does not. Saved input, current owner checks, and workspace errors remain.
Verify fresh WriteProjects/ReadRunSelection authority and resolve the complete checkpoint
Check the current Source Control pin. Return immutable execution metadata; no seed bytes in JSON
Version 2: read bounded raw seed from the fixed Core owner. Verify length and digest, then recheck current metadata before reservation.
Persist accepted intent and fingerprint with PostgreSQL-precision UTC timestamps in owner_effects
Before each effect, recheck authority, command metadata, lease, PVC, and network binding. Reuse the verified seed; do not fetch it again.
Create and verify command-role, operation-scoped offline deny-all policy
Bind the exact policy UID, spec hash, and generation
Persist attempt, then create the accepted command Pod behind a scheduling gate
Return exact Pod UID/resourceVersion and validated command container
Recheck bindings, then release the gate on the exact Pod
Observe exact terminal evidence and bounded command output
Required file outputs after verified command exit zero
Create a separate collector-role offline deny-all policy
Create a separate gated collector Pod with the exact Workspace PVC read-only
Read accepted paths with native no-follow flags and bounded reads on the read-only Workspace
Return bounded regular-file hashes and sizes with Pod UID, container, and request fingerprint
Persist terminal metadata without seed bytes. Replay preserves evidence; reconciliation restores the exact verified seed after matching stored metadata.
Logs are not file evidence. Missing required output is Failed; cancellation, timeout, and limits are Interrupted. Core acknowledges MAF interruption.
